dogecoin.text:
🐶 Elon Musk is again hyping #Dogecoin — he says that for #DOGE it will be possible to buy not only #Tesla merch, but also #SpaceX merch.

The meme-coin reacts with an increase of 8%.

🪙 Today marks the 53rd anniversary of the founder/co-owner of #Tesla, #SpaceX, The Boring Company, owner of X (Twitter), as well as just a lover of #Dogecoin and other meme cryptocurrencies - Elon Musk.

Happy Birthday boss! https://t.co/jw3S2qAQvU
